insights.one_liner: Dapper is an award-winning Rotterdam B2B marketing agency with 70+ people from 20+ nationalities, though it is not a recognised visa sponsor.

culture.text: Dapper has over 70 team members from more than 20 nationalities, working from offices in Rotterdam and Lisbon.
It builds B2B demand-generation marketing for clients in Europe, the UK and the US, with lots of content shared via personal profiles.
Staff often studied economics, marketing or communication at Erasmus University Rotterdam, Rotterdam University of Applied Sciences or Leiden University.

open.text: Dapper is not on the IND list of recognised visa sponsors.
Its one current job here, a marketing internship in Rotterdam, requires Dutch.

growth.text: Founded in Rotterdam in 2019 with two first hires, it grew to over 70 people by 2026, including a 20-person Lisbon team.

worth_knowing.text: It was named Best B2B Growth Agency of the Netherlands in 2023 and Best European B2B Agency in 2025.
